id: # The principal days of the Iglesia Evangélica Luterana en España (IELE), in its one-year series (Serie Anual): the
# calendar of Lutheran Service Book's one-year lectionary, in Spanish, as the IELE's 2025-26 calendar names and colors
# it.  A row with `from` and `to` is a run of Sundays, numbered from `first`.  See docs/traditions.md for the date language.
# Colors as the calendar shades its rows: Advent and Lent violet, Gaudete rose; Palm Sunday and Holy Monday red, Holy
# Tuesday and Wednesday violet; Holy Saturday (Sábado de Gloria) white; Pentecost Monday and Tuesday red.
